_doc: Preprocessor behavior settings. These control how aggressively the EA detects dropped threads, what inbox philosophy to follow, and writing style analysis windows.

inbox_philosophy.mode_doc: inbox_zero: inbox is the task queue, everything gets archived after handling. relaxed: inbox is for reference, archiving is optional, obligations are tracked independently.
inbox_philosophy.read_entire_inbox_doc: In inbox_zero mode, the entire inbox is always read (no time filter) because every message is a potential action item. Set to false to only read recent messages (14 days).
